title: Capability as a governed internal asset
description: The claim, the organizational constraint it removes, the composition model, the anatomy of a persistent agent, the architecture and execution flow, memory and cross-project reuse, governance and failure containment, operating evidence, management economics, and the limits and open questions.

title: 人間ひとり、AI 五十八体。
description: なぜ一人の人間がこの組織を作ったのか、なぜ作れたのか、稼働を始めてから何が起きたのか。家電の量産、SaaS の組織統治、事業売却で学んだ三つのことと、AI 組織が自分で書いた月次レポートの記録。
cta: 創業ストーリーを読む

title: Assemble, deliver, disband
description: What the network believes about work: outcomes over output, the upside it aims at and what it will not do, capability that belongs to the professional, temporary projects and persistent learning, disciplinary difference, the record, accountability, and the human's ownership of purpose and consequence.
